name: D7
summary:
PUDU D7 is Pudu Robotics' industrial semi-humanoid platform. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base with an articulated upper body, allowing manipulation to be carried between work locations rather than confined to a fixed robot cell.

Pudu describes multimodal perception, positioning and navigation, high-payload arms and hybrid control as core components. The learning system is intended to support a range of physical operations, with onboard computing connecting sensor inputs to task execution. D7's practical capabilities depend on the installed end effectors, software and industrial work

description.en:
PUDU D7 is Pudu Robotics' industrial semi-humanoid platform. It combines an omnidirectional mobile base with an articulated upper body, allowing manipulation to be carried between work locations rather than confined to a fixed robot cell.

Pudu describes multimodal perception, positioning and navigation, high-payload arms and hybrid control as core components. The learning system is intended to support a range of physical operations, with onboard computing connecting sensor inputs to task execution. D7's practical capabilities depend on the installed end effectors, software and industrial workflow; its wheeled design should be distinguished from Pudu's bipedal D9.
